feature: Quality Notification Creation from Customer Complaint

TD-CS-047-001.name: Valid Quality Notification from Sales Order — Complete Complaint Data
TD-CS-047-001.expectedOutcome: Quality Notification created with unique number; status Open; routed to QA worklist; status visible on Sales Order

TD-CS-047-002.name: Valid Quality Notification from Return Order — Complete Complaint Data
TD-CS-047-002.expectedOutcome: Quality Notification created from Return Order with unique number; status Open; routed to QA worklist; status visible on Return Order

TD-CS-047-AP-001.name: Quality Notification Status Transition — Open to Under Investigation to Closed
TD-CS-047-AP-001.expectedOutcome: Quality Notification status transitions from Open to Under Investigation to Closed; all mandatory fields recorded

TD-CS-047-AP-002.name: Complaint Report Filtered by Material
TD-CS-047-AP-002.expectedOutcome: Complaint report displays only Quality Notifications associated with the specified material; complaint volume metrics displayed

TD-CS-047-AP-003.name: Complaint Report Filtered by Batch
TD-CS-047-AP-003.expectedOutcome: Complaint report displays only Quality Notifications associated with the specified batch; complaint volume metrics displayed

TD-CS-047-NEG-001.name: Sales Order Missing Material Data — Validation Failure
TD-CS-047-NEG-001.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Material data is missing; Quality Notification not created

TD-CS-047-NEG-002.name: Sales Order Missing Batch Data — Validation Failure
TD-CS-047-NEG-002.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Batch data is missing; Quality Notification not created

TD-CS-047-NEG-003.name: Sales Order Missing Customer Data — Validation Failure
TD-CS-047-NEG-003.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Customer data is missing; Quality Notification not created

TD-CS-047-NEG-004.name: Closure Without Disposition Code — Validation Failure
TD-CS-047-NEG-004.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Disposition Code is required for closure; Quality Notification status remains Open/Under Investigation

TD-CS-047-NEG-005.name: Closure Without Corrective Action — Validation Failure
TD-CS-047-NEG-005.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Corrective Action is required for closure; Quality Notification status remains Open/Under Investigation

TD-CS-047-NEG-006.name: Closure Without Root Cause Analysis — Validation Failure
TD-CS-047-NEG-006.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Root Cause Analysis is required for closure; Quality Notification status remains Open/Under Investigation

TD-CS-047-ERR-001.name: Missing Defect Description — Field Validation Failure
TD-CS-047-ERR-001.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Defect Description is required; Quality Notification not created

TD-CS-047-ERR-002.name: Missing Disposition Code at Closure — Field Validation Failure
TD-CS-047-ERR-002.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Disposition Code is required; Quality Notification status remains Open/Under Investigation

TD-CS-047-ERR-003.name: Missing Corrective Action at Closure — Field Validation Failure
TD-CS-047-ERR-003.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Corrective Action is required; Quality Notification status remains Open/Under Investigation

TD-CS-047-ERR-004.name: Missing Root Cause Analysis at Closure — Field Validation Failure
TD-CS-047-ERR-004.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Root Cause Analysis is required; Quality Notification status remains Open/Under Investigation

TD-CS-047-EDGE-001.name: Defect Description at Minimum Length Boundary (20 characters)
TD-CS-047-EDGE-001.expectedOutcome: Quality Notification created successfully with 20-character Defect Description (GMP minimum boundary)

TD-CS-047-EDGE-002.name: Defect Description at Maximum Length Boundary (1000 characters)
TD-CS-047-EDGE-002.expectedOutcome: Quality Notification created successfully with 1000-character Defect Description (system maximum boundary)

TD-CS-047-EDGE-003.name: Root Cause at Minimum Closure Length Boundary (50 characters)
TD-CS-047-EDGE-003.expectedOutcome: Quality Notification closed successfully with 50-character Root Cause Analysis (GMP minimum boundary for closure)

TD-CS-047-EDGE-004.name: Corrective Action at Minimum Closure Length Boundary (50 characters)
TD-CS-047-EDGE-004.expectedOutcome: Quality Notification closed successfully with 50-character Corrective Action (GMP minimum boundary for closure)

TD-CS-047-INT-001.name: Bidirectional Quality Notification Link — QM to SD Integration
TD-CS-047-INT-001.expectedOutcome: Quality Notification status (Open, Under Investigation, Closed) displays correctly on originating Sales Order; bidirectional link persists through all status transitions

TD-CS-047-INT-002.name: Quality Notification Worklist Routing — QM to Workflow Integration
TD-CS-047-INT-002.expectedOutcome: Quality Notification routes to correct QA team member's worklist; assignment field shows expected QA team or user ID

TD-CS-047-INT-003.name: Complaint Report Data Aggregation — QM to Reporting Integration
TD-CS-047-INT-003.expectedOutcome: Complaint report aggregates data from multiple Quality Notifications; complaint volume and trend metrics displayed correctly
